name: Love, Mafia -My Signore-
source:
Your friend skipped out on paying back his debt to the mafia, and somehow you ended up taking up responsibility for that. While you are in dismay and at a loss for what to do, a certain man appeared in front of you. He said he would pay back the debt for you, yet he's also part of the mafia!

Story Jar's first BL title.
